title: cuphea racemosa subsp. longiflora
intro: Cuphea racemosa subsp. longiflora, commonly known as Yellow Cuphea, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Lythraceae family. This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, where it has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Cuphea, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including reducing inflammation, modulating the immune system, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, gastrointestinal issues, and respiratory problems.
